say.speaker: commander_deino
say.text: Secure the relic! ...Wait. That crest. Another Dragon survivor, fighting for Serperior?

say.speaker: lord
say.text: You’re a Dragon too. Why are you fighting for Ironscale?

say.speaker: commander_deino
say.text: Emperor Kingambit pulled me from the ashes. Kindness won’t seal the Abyss. Only order will.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Careful, {lord}. Get too close and he’ll charge. Let the river work for us.
